mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (user_id, workspace_id, name, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{workspaceId}, #{name}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, workspace_id, name, status, created_at, updated_at FROM project WHERE id = #{projectId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT id, user_id, workspace_id, name, status, created_at, updated_at FROM project WHERE id = #{projectId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, user_id, workspace_id, name, status, created_at, updated_at FROM project WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_number), 0) + 1 FROM project_version WHERE project_id = #{projectId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, project_id, version_number, source_type, source_file_name, source_storage_ref, source_content_hash, status, knowledge_build_status, knowledge_chunk_count, knowledge_build_attempts, knowledge_build_error, knowledge_built_at, total_file_count, parsed_file_count, excluded_file_count, failed_file_count, total_size_bytes, created_at, updated_at FROM project_version WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY version_number DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, project_id, version_number, source_type, source_file_name, source_storage_ref, source_content_hash, status, knowledge_build_status, knowledge_chunk_count, knowledge_build_attempts, knowledge_build_error, knowledge_built_at, total_file_count, parsed_file_count, excluded_file_count, failed_file_count, total_size_bytes, created_at, updated_at FROM project_version WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY version_number DESC

SELECT id, project_id, version_number, source_type, source_file_name, source_storage_ref, source_content_hash, status, knowledge_build_status, knowledge_chunk_count, knowledge_build_attempts, knowledge_build_error, knowledge_built_at, total_file_count, parsed_file_count, excluded_file_count, failed_file_count, total_size_bytes, created_at, updated_at FROM project_version WHERE id = #{versionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE project_version SET knowledge_build_status = 'READY', knowledge_chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, knowledge_build_error = NULL, knowledge_built_at = #{builtAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{versionId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_version_id, relative_path, relative_path_hash, media_type, size_bytes, storage_ref, content_hash, status, status_reason, created_at FROM project_file WHERE project_version_id = #{projectVersionId} ORDER BY relative_path
